note: Temperance River State Park's upper campground, on the Lake Superior shore east of the Temperance River mouth, between Highway 61 and the lake. Sites sit among spruce clumps and grass on the shore terrace; trails near sites 14 and 25 lead down to the rock shoreline and splash pools below the campground. The Temperance River gorge trail and Hidden Falls are nearby. One of four North Shore state parks with electric hookups. --Claude
summary: DNR record + ReserveMN read: 36 drive-in sites (19 electric, A/B 50-amp, others 30-amp), pads 38-126 ft (all fit 23 ft); $24 / $34 confirmed; season Apr 30 - Oct 24 (2027); showers/flush toilets, no dump. Sites 18 -> 36; platform operator -> usedirect. Note's 'north of Hwy 61 along the gorge' was wrong (the loop is on the Lake Superior shore). Waterfront lead not waterfront -> lakeview. Phone none -> 218-663-3100.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD not waterfront -> lakeview: the ReserveMN unit points (matching the loop roads on imagery) put this campground SOUTH of Highway 61 on the Lake Superior shore terrace, not north of the highway as the old note said. Sites 22E (47.55468,-90.87033), 14 (47.55448,-90.87109), 15 (47.55431,-90.87142), 12 (47.55418,-90.87171) and 23E (47.55500,-90.87000) sit about 75-115 m from the water, with mostly open grass and bare shore rock between (a few spruce clumps); none is within 50 m of the water, so no lakefront. ReserveMN's 'Lake/River/Creek' attribute shows '.25 mile' on A and B only; the DNR names lake views only for the lower campground ('Some sites in the lower campground have an excellent view of the lake'). A sightline over open ground from these sites looks likely; no official site photos were found to confirm it. DNR notes: 'Visit the rock shoreline and splash pools below the upper campground. Trails accessing this area can be found near campsites #14 or #25.' At the least `coastal walk` (Lake Superior shore within ~100 m, park ground between) applies.

Pin 47.55720,-90.87130 is ~230 m north of the centroid of the 39 ReserveMN unit points (47.55515,-90.87116; span 47.55378-47.55754, -90.87317 to -90.86889). Under 250 m; optional move to 47.55515,-90.87116.
